title: An Island of Changed Faces
description: Learn what the Pope knows about the changed inhabitants and the dangerous north.
completion_text: The island changes people for unknown reasons. Beyond the northern ice, the Shipbreaker haunts wrecked ships.

stages.title: The Island's Changes
stages.lead: Ask the Pope why the island's people are different.
notes: People were once human; the change doesn't erase their memories.

objectives.description: Ask the Pope about the island's curse.

stages.title: The Northern Warning
stages.lead: Ask about the wrecks in the frozen north.
notes: The Shipbreaker is a warning, not an early-game target.

objectives.description: Ask the Pope about the frozen north.
